package ar.edu.utn.frc.tup.piv.evaluacionllm;

/** Fixture: codigo nuevo sin un solo test que lo toque. */
public class SinCobertura {

    public int weightedScore(int clarity, int depth, int accuracy) {
        int total = 0;
        if (clarity > 0) {
            total += clarity * 2;
        }
        if (depth > 0) {
            total += depth * 3;
        }
        if (accuracy > 0) {
            total += accuracy * 5;
        }
        return total;
    }

    public boolean passes(int score) {
        return score >= 60;
    }
}
